name: audio-splitter
description: Cut a long recording into tracks: a lecture into chapters, a podcast into segments, a live set into songs. Open an audio file (or a video's soundtrack) and it is split at the pauses, at a fixed length, or at the times in your chapter list; add a plain list of titles and the tracks are named in order. Very short pieces are merged into their neighbours and over-long ones are cut again at their longest pause. Move any cut point, rename or skip tracks, then export numbered audio files (copied without re-encoding, or as MP3, M4A or WAV, with title, track and album tags), a track list CSV, YouTube-style chapter timestamps and a CUE sheet. Runs locally with ffmpeg; no account or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把长录音切成多段：讲座按章节、播客按段落、现场录音按歌曲。打开音频（或视频的声音），可以按停顿自动切、按固定时长切，或者按章节表里的时间切；再给一份只有标题的清单，就按顺序给每段命名。太短的片段会并到相邻段，太长的会在最长的停顿处再切一刀。每个切点都能改，可以改名或跳过某段，最后导出带序号的音频文件（不重新编码直接复制，或转成 MP3、M4A、WAV，并写入标题、音轨号、专辑标签）、分段清单 CSV、YouTube 章节时间戳和 CUE 文件。在本地用 ffmpeg 运行，不用登录，无需 API 密钥。
